en: Black‑and‑white view of a European town square or street corner with cobblestones and a low picket fence in the foreground. On the left is a two‑story building with a sign reading "Hotel zur ..." partially obscured by ivy and bushes. In the center background stands a taller, ornate public building with a tower and spire, likely a town hall or civic building. On the right is a three‑story historic building with arched ground‑floor openings and shopfronts; one clearly bears a large sign "MILKA" above the entrance and another smaller "MILKA" sign in the window. There are mature trees and a small monument or column in a planted area between the buildings.
